author: 滇西小哥 Dianxi Xiaoge
description:
※Click "cc" on the lower right menu to choose your subtitle language.

In Yunnan, fruit is not only used in dishes, but also mixed with salt and chili to make a refreshing, appetizing snack. For fruits that are too sour, you can add a little sugar. For sweeter fruits, just add some dipping chili, roasted chili powder, and a tiny bit of MSG. Sour, sweet, salty, and spicy all at once — it’s the kind of flavor that makes every Yunnan person’s mouth water the moment they see it.
When you have no appetite in summer, start with some fruit pickles to wake up your taste buds, then have a bit of cold noodles and green chili chicken to fill your stomach. Finish with a bowl of sweet chilled pineapple, and life feels truly wonderful...

Hello, everyone! I am Dianxi Xiaoge, a Yunnan native. If you enjoy my videos, please keep subscribing to my channel. I'll continue to share my life and Yunnan-styled food in my uploads. Wish you have a happy life and enjoy tasty food every day
